From grid to fabric

  1. Enter the width and height of a measured area on your mat.
  2. Enter fullscreen first, then drag the projected grid corners to match that area.
  3. Choose Continue to pattern and open a file. PDFs use their native print size.
  4. Use Stitch for tiled PDFs, Layers for pattern sizes, and Scale to check a known test line or square.

Moving the projector, changing browser zoom, or changing displays can affect calibration. Use the grid or a size-check overlay to verify alignment.
